_comment: The project the pipeline works on. The active one is config/project.json;
copy a design's project.json there (or paste it on the app's Project page)
to switch. Nothing else in the application is design-specific.
Paths are relative to the repository root.
knowledge_sources: folders indexed into the knowledge base. kind is one of
spec       requirements, register maps, design notes (.md .txt .rst)
rtl        design source (.sv .v .svh .vh)
testbench  verification code the test agent learns helpers from
Non-text specs (xlsx) are converted to Markdown first:
python -m asic_agent.knowledge.xlsx_to_md <file.xlsx>
testbench contract (see designs/apb_gpio/tb/tb_apb_gpio.sv):
- one test per task, selected at run time with +TEST=<name>
- each test prints 'RESULT <name> PASS' or 'RESULT <name> FAIL <reason>'
- two marker comments: '@agent-tests' (new tasks go above it) and
'@agent-dispatch' (new dispatcher entries go above it)
- the helper tasks a test may call are listed in helper_tasks
testbench.metadata (optional): per-test spec_ref / pass_condition used by
rule-based diagnosis.
fault_scenarios (optional): verification-run scenarios offered in the app.
rtl_edit: regex 'pattern' -> 'replace' applied once to the run's RTL copy;
enable_tests: run tests that are normally excluded.
name: apb_gpio — PULP platform

testbench.signals_note: gpio_in drives the pads; irq is the DUT interrupt output; rd (logic [31:0]) and hi (int) are scratch variables declared in the testbench.

fault_scenarios.label: Injected RTL bug
fault_scenarios.description: Rising-edge interrupts decode the falling edge. The spec is clear; the RTL is wrong.
fault_scenarios.note: Injected implementation bug: INTTYPE=01 decodes the falling edge, contradicting the spec's 'interrupt on rising edge'.

fault_scenarios.label: Injected RTL bug, falling edge
fault_scenarios.description: Falling-edge interrupts decode the rising edge. Similar to a fix already in the knowledge base, but not the same.
fault_scenarios.note: Injected implementation bug: INTTYPE=00 decodes the rising edge, contradicting the spec's 'interrupt on falling edge'.

fault_scenarios.label: Spec gap probe
fault_scenarios.description: Adds a test assuming INTTYPE=11 is a level interrupt. The spec only says "RFU".
fault_scenarios.note: Injected spec gap: optional test inttype_rfu_level expects INTTYPE=11 to be a level interrupt. The spec only says 'RFU'.
